description: This file implements an admin page for managing connector integrations in a web application, including listing connectors, and providing options to disconnect, refresh tokens, and connect new connectors. It uses React hooks, SWR for data fetching, and custom API modules.

methods.name: AdminConnectorsPage
methods.description: React component rendering the admin connectors management page, including data fetching, state management, and UI interactions.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Asynchronous function to disconnect a connector provider and update UI state.

methods.name: refreshToken
methods.description: Asynchronous function to request a token refresh for a connector provider.
